items.html: And on the third day, when all gather together — the half of Aba with the half of Ima — they joined, and we find that the halves of the middle line did not join until this day. And opposite this, six other sparks enter him, opposite the middle line. Thus they were completed, in the three days of absorption, to enter all within Ima and to be tied together, all of them, in the secret of lines; and to enter within them the nineteen sparks of life, which are the filling of MA, which is the life of ZA himself, as above. And the existence of these three Vavs of the three days of absorption is the phase of the three Alephs that there are in the filling of MA.
